questions.q: Hair that tangles at the tips and sticks together so that it cannot be combed (plica polonica) is a keynote of:
questions.why: Borax: hair frowzy and tangled, splits and sticks together at the tips (Boericke, Allen).

questions.q: Tenderness in the anatomical snuffbox after a fall on the outstretched hand suggests a fracture of the scaphoid, whose feared complication is:
opts: avascular necrosis of the proximal fragment
questions.why: The scaphoid's blood supply enters distally, so the proximal pole may lose its supply and necrose.

questions.q: Which remedy is regarded as the chronic of Apis mellifica?
questions.why: Natrum muriaticum is the chronic of Apis, as it is of Ignatia.

questions.q: The 1 : 50,000 ratio of each LM step arises because:
opts: one drop is added to 100 drops of alcohol, and one medicated globule carries about 1/500 of a drop
fifty succussions are given to a 1:1000 dilution
each step adds one drop to 500 drops and gives 100 succussions
one grain is diluted in 50,000 grains of lactose
questions.why: A drop moistens about 500 globules, so one globule holds about 1/500 drop; dissolving it and adding 100 drops gives 1/100 × 1/500 = 1/50,000.

questions.q: In Kent's Repertory, yawning is found in the chapter:
questions.why: Kent places yawning under Sleep, alongside sleepiness and sleeplessness.

questions.q: Hahnemann regarded animal magnetism (mesmerism) in §288 as:
questions.why: Topic 1, Organon and Philosophy. He discussed it as a dynamic healing influence.

questions.q: In a chronic case where the patient has been taking medicines up to the time of the visit, §91 advises the physician to:
opts: record the case at once, as the drug symptoms are part of the disease
continue the old medicines and add the homoeopathic remedy
leave him some days without medicine before taking the final picture
antidote the old medicines immediately with Nux vomica
questions.why: §91: symptoms during a course of medicine do not give the pure picture; in chronic cases the patient may be left a few days without medicine.

questions.q: Hilton's method of draining an abscess in the axilla or neck involves:
opts: deep sharp incision straight into the cavity
incising the skin and opening the cavity with blunt sinus forceps
complete excision of the abscess wall
questions.why: Blunt opening after a skin incision avoids injury to the important vessels and nerves nearby.

questions.q: Excessive weakness, prostration and trembling in alcoholics, with vomiting of sour food and a desire for stimulants, suggest:
questions.why: Topic 2, Materia Medica. Sulphuric acid: hurry, weakness, sour discharges.

questions.q: Mental symptoms such as depression or irritability arising as ill effects of a head injury call for:
questions.why: Natrum sulph is known for chronic mental effects of injuries to the head.
